files.components/button.yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../../../schema/component.schema.json
# M3 common buttons (filled / outlined / text / elevated / filled tonal), material-web v0.192 tokens.
# The five styles share one UI tree, so `style` is a mode prop: per-style values are this component's tokens
# (data.tokens, `$when: style=…`). Only withIcon (adds the icon part) is a variant.
kind: Component
metadata:
  id: button
  name: Button
  description: M3 common button. Spacing values missing from material-web v0.192 tokens come from the M3 spec.
data:
  props:
    label: { type: text, default: "{text.button.label}" }
    style: { type: mode, values: [filled, outlined, text, elevated, tonal], default: filled, description: "filled | outlined | text | elevated | tonal. Only token values differ, so it is a mode, not a variant" }
    icon:  { type: instance, default: icon-add, preferred: [icon-add, icon-star], description: Leading icon (withIcon=true) }
  variants:
    withIcon:
      values: { "false": {}, "true": { description: "Leading icon shown; leading padding shrinks" } }
      default: "false"
  states: [enabled, hovered, focused, pressed, disabled]
  # The tokens this component uses ("{button.<name>}"), values from material-web v0.192 component tokens. $when = the value for that style.
  tokens:
    icon-label-space: { $type: dimension, $value: { value: 8, unit: px } }
    block-space: { $type: dimension, $value: "{md.sys.space.zero}" }
    trailing-space:
      $type: dimension
      $value: { value: 24, unit: px }
      $when:
        style=text: { value: 12, unit: px }
    leading-space:
      $type: dimension
      $value: { value: 24, unit: px }
      $when:
        style=text: { value: 12, unit: px }
    container-height: { $type: dimension, $value: { value: 40, unit: px } }
    container-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.primary}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.color.transparent}"
        style=text: "{md.sys.color.transparent}"
        style=elevated: "{md.sys.color.surface-container-low}"
        style=tonal: "{md.sys.color.secondary-container}"
    container-shape: { $type: dimension, $value: "{md.sys.shape.corner-full}" }
    shadow:
      $type: shadow
      $value: "{md.sys.elevation-shadow.level0}"
      $when:
        style=elevated: "{md.sys.elevation-shadow.level1}"
    outline-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.transparent}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.color.outline}"
    outline-width:
      $type: dimension
      $value: "{md.sys.space.zero}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: { value: 1, unit: px }
    state-layer-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.on-primary}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.color.primary}"
        style=text: "{md.sys.color.primary}"
        style=elevated: "{md.sys.color.primary}"
        style=tonal: "{md.sys.color.on-secondary-container}"
    enabled-state-layer-opacity: { $type: number, $value: "{md.sys.opacity.zero}" }
    icon-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.on-primary}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.color.primary}"
        style=text: "{md.sys.color.primary}"
        style=elevated: "{md.sys.color.primary}"
        style=tonal: "{md.sys.color.on-secondary-container}"
    with-icon-icon-size: { $type: dimension, $value: { value: 18, unit: px } }
    label-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.on-primary}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.color.primary}"
        style=text: "{md.sys.color.primary}"
        style=elevated: "{md.sys.color.primary}"
        style=tonal: "{md.sys.color.on-secondary-container}"
    label-text-typography: { $type: typography, $value: "{md.sys.typescale.label-large}" }
    hover-shadow:
      $type: shadow
      $value: "{md.sys.elevation-shadow.level1}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.elevation-shadow.level0}"
        style=text: "{md.sys.elevation-shadow.level0}"
        style=elevated: "{md.sys.elevation-shadow.level2}"
    hover-state-layer-opacity: { $type: number, $value: "{md.sys.state.hover-state-layer-opacity}" }
    focus-outline-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.transparent}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.color.primary}"
    focus-state-layer-opacity: { $type: number, $value: "{md.sys.state.focus-state-layer-opacity}" }
    pressed-state-layer-opacity: { $type: number, $value: "{md.sys.state.pressed-state-layer-opacity}" }
    disabled-container-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.on-surface}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.color.transparent}"
        style=text: "{md.sys.color.transparent}"
    disabled-container-opacity:
      $type: number
      $value: 0.12
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.opacity.zero}"
        style=text: "{md.sys.opacity.zero}"
    disabled-shadow: { $type: shadow, $value: "{md.sys.elevation-shadow.level0}" }
    disabled-outline-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.transparent}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.color.on-surface}"
    disabled-outline-opacity:
      $type: number
      $value: "{md.sys.opacity.zero}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: 0.12
    disabled-label-text-color: { $type: color, $value: "{md.sys.color.on-surface}" }
    disabled-label-text-opacity: { $type: number, $value: 0.38 }
    with-icon-disabled-icon-color: { $type: color, $value: "{md.sys.color.on-surface}" }
    with-icon-disabled-icon-opacity: { $type: number, $value: 0.38 }
    with-icon-trailing-space:
      $type: dimension
      $value: { value: 24, unit: px }
      $when:
        style=text: { value: 16, unit: px }
    with-icon-leading-space:
      $type: dimension
      $value: { value: 16, unit: px }
      $when:
        style=text: { value: 12, unit: px }
  anatomy:
    root:
      kind: frame
      layout:
        direction: row
        gap: "{button.icon-label-space}"
        padding: ["{button.block-space}", "{button.trailing-space}", "{button.block-space}", "{button.leading-space}"]
        align: { main: center, cross: center }
        width: hug
        height: "{button.container-height}"
      children:
        stateLayer: { kind: frame, layout: { position: absolute, width: fill, height: fill } }
        icon:       { kind: instance, prop: icon }
        label:      { kind: text, text: { prop: label } }
  styles:
    base:
      enabled:
        root:       { fill: "{button.container-color}", cornerRadius: "{button.container-shape}", shadow: "{button.shadow}", strokeColor: "{button.outline-color}", strokeWidth: "{button.outline-width}" }
        stateLayer: { fill: "{button.state-layer-color}", cornerRadius: "{button.container-shape}", opacity: "{button.enabled-state-layer-opacity}" }
        icon:       { fill: "{button.icon-color}", width: "{button.with-icon-icon-size}", height: "{button.with-icon-icon-size}" }
        label:      { color: "{button.label-color}", typography: "{button.label-text-typography}" }
      hovered:
        root:       { shadow: "{button.hover-shadow}" }
        stateLayer: { opacity: "{button.hover-state-layer-opacity}" }
      focused:
        root:       { strokeColor: "{button.focus-outline-color}" }
        stateLayer: { opacity: "{button.focus-state-layer-opacity}" }
      pressed:
        stateLayer: { opacity: "{button.pressed-state-layer-opacity}" }
      disabled:
        root:  { fill: "{button.disabled-container-color}", fillOpacity: "{button.disabled-container-opacity}", shadow: "{button.disabled-shadow}", strokeColor: "{button.disabled-outline-color}", strokeOpacity: "{button.disabled-outline-opacity}" }
        label: { color: "{button.disabled-label-text-color}", opacity: "{button.disabled-label-text-opacity}" }
        icon:  { fill: "{button.with-icon-disabled-icon-color}", fillOpacity: "{button.with-icon-disabled-icon-opacity}" }

    # withIcon changes the UI tree (the icon part), so it is a variant; its padding values are tokens too
    withIcon=false:
      enabled:
        icon: { visible: false }
    withIcon=true:
      enabled:
        root: { padding: ["{button.block-space}", "{button.with-icon-trailing-space}", "{button.block-space}", "{button.with-icon-leading-space}"] }
files.components/card.yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../../../schema/component.schema.json
# M3 cards (elevated / filled / outlined), material-web v0.192 tokens. Content is a slot.
# One UI tree for all styles: `style` is a mode prop (data.tokens `$when: style=…`), not a variant.
kind: Component
metadata:
  id: card
  name: Card
  description: M3 card container. Layout inside the card is up to the slot content.
data:
  props:
    content: { type: slot, min: 1, description: "Card content (media, text, actions)" }
    style:   { type: mode, values: [elevated, filled, outlined], default: elevated, description: "elevated | filled | outlined (token mode)" }
  states: [enabled, hovered, focused, pressed, disabled]
  # The tokens this component uses ("{card.<name>}"), values from material-web v0.192 component tokens. $when = the value for that style.
  tokens:
    content-gap: { $type: dimension, $value: { value: 8, unit: px } }
    padding: { $type: dimension, $value: { value: 16, unit: px } }
    preview-width: { $type: dimension, $value: { value: 360, unit: px } }
    container-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.surface-container-low}"
      $when:
        style=filled: "{md.sys.color.surface-container-highest}"
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.color.surface}"
    container-shape: { $type: dimension, $value: "{md.sys.shape.corner-medium}" }
    outline-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.transparent}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.color.outline-variant}"
    outline-width:
      $type: dimension
      $value: "{md.sys.space.zero}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: { value: 1, unit: px }
    shadow:
      $type: shadow
      $value: "{md.sys.elevation-shadow.level1}"
      $when:
        style=filled: "{md.sys.elevation-shadow.level0}"
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.elevation-shadow.level0}"
    enabled-state-layer-opacity: { $type: number, $value: "{md.sys.opacity.zero}" }
    hover-state-layer-color: { $type: color, $value: "{md.sys.color.on-surface}" }
    hover-shadow:
      $type: shadow
      $value: "{md.sys.elevation-shadow.level2}"
      $when:
        style=filled: "{md.sys.elevation-shadow.level1}"
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.elevation-shadow.level1}"
    hover-state-layer-opacity: { $type: number, $value: "{md.sys.state.hover-state-layer-opacity}" }
    focus-outline-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.transparent}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.color.on-surface}"
    focus-state-layer-opacity: { $type: number, $value: "{md.sys.state.focus-state-layer-opacity}" }
    pressed-state-layer-opacity: { $type: number, $value: "{md.sys.state.pressed-state-layer-opacity}" }
    disabled-container-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.surface}"
      $when:
        style=filled: "{md.sys.color.surface-variant}"
    disabled-container-opacity:
      $type: number
      $value: 0.38
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.opacity.full}"
    disabled-outline-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.transparent}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.color.outline}"
    disabled-outline-opacity:
      $type: number
      $value: "{md.sys.opacity.zero}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: 0.12
  anatomy:
    root:
      kind: frame
      layout: { direction: column, gap: "{card.content-gap}", padding: "{card.padding}", width: "{card.preview-width}", height: hug }
      children:
        stateLayer: { kind: frame, layout: { position: absolute, width: fill, height: fill } }
        body:       { kind: slot, prop: content, layout: { direction: column, gap: "{card.content-gap}", width: fill } }
  styles:
    base:
      enabled:
        root:       { fill: "{card.container-color}", cornerRadius: "{card.container-shape}", strokeColor: "{card.outline-color}", strokeWidth: "{card.outline-width}", shadow: "{card.shadow}" }
        stateLayer: { cornerRadius: "{card.container-shape}", opacity: "{card.enabled-state-layer-opacity}", fill: "{card.hover-state-layer-color}" }
      hovered:
        root:       { shadow: "{card.hover-shadow}" }
        stateLayer: { opacity: "{card.hover-state-layer-opacity}" }
      focused:
        root:       { strokeColor: "{card.focus-outline-color}" }
        stateLayer: { opacity: "{card.focus-state-layer-opacity}" }
      pressed:
        stateLayer: { opacity: "{card.pressed-state-layer-opacity}" }
      disabled:
        root: { fill: "{card.disabled-container-color}", fillOpacity: "{card.disabled-container-opacity}", strokeColor: "{card.disabled-outline-color}", strokeOpacity: "{card.disabled-outline-opacity}" }
files.components/icon-button.yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../../../schema/component.schema.json
# M3 icon buttons (standard / filled / filled tonal / outlined), unselected (non-toggle) form, material-web v0.192 tokens.
# One UI tree for all styles: `style` is a mode prop (data.tokens `$when: style=…`), not a variant.
kind: Component
metadata:
  id: icon-button
  name: Icon button
  description: M3 icon button, non-toggle. Toggle (selected) variants are out of scope for the pilot.
data:
  props:
    icon: { type: instance, default: icon-star, preferred: [icon-star, icon-add] }
    style: { type: mode, values: [standard, filled, tonal, outlined], default: standard, description: "standard | filled | tonal | outlined (token mode)" }
  states: [enabled, hovered, focused, pressed, disabled]
  # The tokens this component uses ("{icon-button.<name>}"), values from material-web v0.192 component tokens. $when = the value for that style.
  tokens:
    container-width: { $type: dimension, $value: { value: 40, unit: px } }
    container-height: { $type: dimension, $value: { value: 40, unit: px } }
    container-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.transparent}"
      $when:
        style=filled: "{md.sys.color.primary}"
        style=tonal: "{md.sys.color.secondary-container}"
    container-shape: { $type: dimension, $value: "{md.sys.shape.corner-full}" }
    outline-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.transparent}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.color.outline}"
    outline-width:
      $type: dimension
      $value: "{md.sys.space.zero}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: { value: 1, unit: px }
    state-layer-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.on-surface-variant}"
      $when:
        style=filled: "{md.sys.color.on-primary}"
        style=tonal: "{md.sys.color.on-secondary-container}"
    state-layer-shape: { $type: dimension, $value: "{md.sys.shape.corner-full}" }
    enabled-state-layer-opacity: { $type: number, $value: "{md.sys.opacity.zero}" }
    icon-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.on-surface-variant}"
      $when:
        style=filled: "{md.sys.color.on-primary}"
        style=tonal: "{md.sys.color.on-secondary-container}"
    icon-size: { $type: dimension, $value: { value: 24, unit: px } }
    hover-state-layer-opacity: { $type: number, $value: "{md.sys.state.hover-state-layer-opacity}" }
    focus-state-layer-opacity:
      $type: number
      $value: "{md.sys.state.focus-state-layer-opacity}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.state.hover-state-layer-opacity}"
    pressed-state-layer-opacity: { $type: number, $value: "{md.sys.state.pressed-state-layer-opacity}" }
    pressed-state-layer-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.on-surface-variant}"
      $when:
        style=filled: "{md.sys.color.on-primary}"
        style=tonal: "{md.sys.color.on-secondary-container}"
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.color.on-surface}"
    pressed-icon-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.on-surface-variant}"
      $when:
        style=filled: "{md.sys.color.on-primary}"
        style=tonal: "{md.sys.color.on-secondary-container}"
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.color.on-surface}"
    disabled-container-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.transparent}"
      $when:
        style=filled: "{md.sys.color.on-surface}"
        style=tonal: "{md.sys.color.on-surface}"
    disabled-container-opacity:
      $type: number
      $value: "{md.sys.opacity.zero}"
      $when:
        style=filled: 0.12
        style=tonal: 0.12
    disabled-outline-color:
      $type: color
      $value: "{md.sys.color.transparent}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: "{md.sys.color.on-surface}"
    disabled-outline-opacity:
      $type: number
      $value: "{md.sys.opacity.zero}"
      $when:
        style=outlined: 0.12
    disabled-icon-color: { $type: color, $value: "{md.sys.color.on-surface}" }
    disabled-icon-opacity: { $type: number, $value: 0.38 }
  anatomy:
    root:
      kind: frame
      layout:
        direction: row
        align: { main: center, cross: center }
        width: "{icon-button.container-width}"
        height: "{icon-button.container-height}"
      children:
        stateLayer: { kind: frame, layout: { position: absolute, width: fill, height: fill } }
        icon:       { kind: instance, prop: icon }
  styles:
    base:
      enabled:
        root:       { fill: "{icon-button.container-color}", cornerRadius: "{icon-button.container-shape}", strokeColor: "{icon-button.outline-color}", strokeWidth: "{icon-button.outline-width}" }
        stateLayer: { fill: "{icon-button.state-layer-color}", cornerRadius: "{icon-button.state-layer-shape}", opacity: "{icon-button.enabled-state-layer-opacity}" }
        icon:       { fill: "{icon-button.icon-color}", width: "{icon-button.icon-size}", height: "{icon-button.icon-size}" }
      hovered:
        stateLayer: { opacity: "{icon-button.hover-state-layer-opacity}" }
      focused:
        stateLayer: { opacity: "{icon-button.focus-state-layer-opacity}" }
      pressed:
        stateLayer: { opacity: "{icon-button.pressed-state-layer-opacity}", fill: "{icon-button.pressed-state-layer-color}" }
        icon:       { fill: "{icon-button.pressed-icon-color}" }
      disabled:
        root: { fill: "{icon-button.disabled-container-color}", fillOpacity: "{icon-button.disabled-container-opacity}", strokeColor: "{icon-button.disabled-outline-color}", strokeOpacity: "{icon-button.disabled-outline-opacity}" }
        icon: { fill: "{icon-button.disabled-icon-color}", fillOpacity: "{icon-button.disabled-icon-opacity}" }
files.openui.yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../../schema/manifest.schema.json
openui: "0.1"
info:
  title: Material 3 (material-web v0.192)
  version: 0.1.0
  description: Pilot Material 3 components specified in OpenUI YAML. Tokens converted from material-web@268681913e0a (Apache-2.0).
tokens: tokens/material3.resolver.yaml
components: ["components/*.yaml"]
checklists: ["checklists/*.yaml"]

# yaml-language-server: $schema=../../schema/manifest.schema.json
openui: "0.1"
info:
  title: OpenUI conformance
  version: 0.1.0
  description: Minimal fixtures that exercise every v0.1 concept (tokens, modes, props, variants, states, layout, slots).
tokens: tokens/conformance.resolver.yaml
components: ["components/*.yaml"]
checklists: ["checklists/*.yaml"]
files.tokens/conformance.resolver.yaml:
version: "2025.10"
name: conformance
description: >
  Modes and when they apply (org.openui.when). window, orientation and device hold no global tokens:
  component tokens say what they are in each context with $when (spec §4.7).
sets:
  base:
    sources: [{ $ref: base.tokens.yaml }]
modifiers:
  theme:
    description: Color theme
    contexts:
      light: [{ $ref: light.tokens.yaml }]
      dark: [{ $ref: dark.tokens.yaml }]
    default: light
    $extensions:
      org.openui: { when: { light: { colorScheme: light }, dark: { colorScheme: dark } } }
  locale:
    description: UI language (BCP 47). Holds the text tokens.
    contexts:
      en: [{ $ref: text.en.tokens.yaml }]
      ko: [{ $ref: text.ko.tokens.yaml }]
    default: en
    $extensions:
      org.openui: { when: { en: { language: en }, ko: { language: ko } } }
  window:
    description: Window width class (breakpoints in dp)
    contexts:
      compact: []
      medium: []
      expanded: []
    default: compact
    $extensions:
      org.openui:
        when:
          compact: { width: { max: 600 } }
          medium: { width: { min: 600, max: 840 } }
          expanded: { width: { min: 840 } }
  orientation:
    description: Screen orientation
    contexts:
      portrait: []
      landscape: []
    default: portrait
    $extensions:
      org.openui: { when: { portrait: { orientation: portrait }, landscape: { orientation: landscape } } }
  device:
    description: Device type
    contexts:
      phone: []
      tablet: []
      desktop: []
    default: phone
    $extensions:
      org.openui: { when: { phone: { device: phone }, tablet: { device: tablet }, desktop: { device: desktop } } }
resolutionOrder:
  - { $ref: "#/sets/base" }
  - { $ref: "#/modifiers/theme" }
  - { $ref: "#/modifiers/locale" }
  - { $ref: "#/modifiers/window" }
  - { $ref: "#/modifiers/orientation" }
  - { $ref: "#/modifiers/device" }
